```

(
    user_field String,
    ...

)

```

UPDATE RollUpField = [1234,321,123456.....] -- length of the array is 56000
WHERE auto_user_id  = 296976 AND counts = 986;

### What is the Error
Max query size exceeded: '280520'

### What I did ?

I tried setting up `SET max_query_size=17000000000` but in that case the `ALTER` command is not throwing error but at the same time it is not updating the column.

Can anyone help me on this please ?
